svg.title: Unequal crossing over expands or contracts a tandem duplication
svg.desc: Two homologs each have two sister chromatids. In normal pairing the two amber repeats align. In mispairing, L on the blue homolog aligns with R on the violet homolog. The inner nonsister chromatids cross over inside those repeats. From top to bottom, the products carry two, one, three, and two copies. The two altered products exchange distal arms. Source: LECT12E slide 7, schematic lengths.
